xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #5171

plan.title: bug(session): finalize-owed tip inventory does O(n) git show of every completed xBRIEF; --defer-owed still scans (~10min)

narratives.Overview: Bound from design-critique #5171. Batch finalize-owed tip inventory via showBlobsBatch; reverse Prefer-A inventory skip; keep scan on every mutation session start.
narratives.AcceptanceCriteria:
finalize-owed tip plan reads use showBlobsBatch (chunked under 64MiB); silent whole-N git show fallback is not a green path
discoverFinalizeOwed uses one list -> batch -> Map; tipHasTwin/completed loop do not re-spawn git show for mapped paths
evaluateFinalizeOwedSessionGate no longer skips discoverFinalizeOwed when --defer-owed is set; defer only clears blocks
focused tests lock batch/chunk inventory and deferred-still-inventories behavior
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry for the fix
